articles.summary: ANDOVER, Mass., Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TransMedics Group, Inc. ("TransMedics") (Nasdaq: TMDX), the global leader in portable warm perfusion for donor organs for transplantation, today announced the appointment of Fernando Araujo as Chief Financial Officer, effective September 21, 2026.
